newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks firm in London on Sony results.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks firm in London on Sony results.

text.p: Japanese stocks were mostly higher in London on Thursday, boosted by good results from Sony Corp, dealers said.
After the Tokyo close on Thursday, Sony reported first quarter profits more than doubled, raising hopes for similarly strong results from other exporters, dealers said.
Shares in Sony were up some 60 to 70 yen over the Tokyo close, they said.
"Sony shares have had a good run, so they may not rise much more, but there's a feeling that other exporters will start to take off," said one London dealer.
Drawing the most interest were shares in Toyota Motor Corp, which rose eight yen over Tokyo's close, and shares in Toshiba Corp, which added 10 to 15 yen over their closing level in Tokyo, they said.
The Nikkei 50 average was up 5.02 points to 1,725.48 at 1349 GMT in London.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 index finished with a 118.61 point gain to 20,331.43.
